name: gVisor
description: Google's user-space application kernel for workload isolation, delivered as the runsc OCI runtime.
descriptionZh: Google 的用户态应用内核隔离方案，以 runsc 这一 OCI runtime 交付。
keyFact: gVisor is Google's Apache-2.0 sandbox that implements a user-space application kernel (Sentry plus Gofer) and ships as the runsc OCI runtime; it is neither a hypervisor nor a syscall filter, and is used by Google Cloud Run and GKE Sandbox.
keyFactZh: gVisor 是 Google 以 Apache-2.0 开源的隔离方案，实现了用户态应用内核（Sentry + Gofer），以 runsc 这一 OCI runtime 形式交付；它既非 hypervisor 也非 syscall filter，被 Google Cloud Run 与 GKE Sandbox 采用。
caveat: The commonly quoted '200-500ms cold start' has no official published figure; observed numbers range widely (roughly 100ms to multiple seconds) depending on platform and configuration.
caveatZh: 常被引用的“200-500ms 冷启动”并无官方定值；实测数字随平台与配置差异极大（约 100ms 到数秒不等）。
